framing.lineOfInquiry: Mohit Bajwa (P00102) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE018
framing.alternate: Mohit Bajwa (P00102) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Mohit Bajwa was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded in the FIR as witness, not as accused
FIR text contains: '…no role has been attributed…'

alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
alternateHypotheses.statement: Mohit Bajwa was near the scene because they regularly go there (home, work, market), not because of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded within 1 km of the scene on 42 other days (23 Feb – 22 Apr), so presence there is part of their routine

alternateHypotheses.test: Establish why the person is regularly there (address, employment, shop) and compare the incident-time visit with their usual pattern (time of day, duration).

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Mohit Bajwa's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: In contact with Harleen Chauhan since 2025-02-23, 29 days before the incident (9 calls, 7 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Pooja Sidhu since 2025-02-24, 28 days before the incident (8 calls, 4 messages) — a long-standing relationship
In contact with Rohit Aggarwal since 2025-02-24, 28 days before the incident (4 calls, 3 messages) — a long-standing relationship

alternateHypotheses.test: Examine message content and the timing of contact relative to the incident; establish the relationship.

alternateHypotheses.title: The location records are unreliable
alternateHypotheses.statement: Mohit Bajwa's location records are imprecise or inconsistent (tower-level accuracy, cloned or shared SIM), so they do not reliably place them at the scene.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Location inconsistency (requires air travel): Connaught Place Offices, Delhi → Hall Bazaar, Amritsar, 402.67 km in 56.0 min

alternateHypotheses.test: Request a tower dump and the handset's GPS logs; check for SIM cloning; rely on high-accuracy fixes only.

The money has a legitimate explanation
